# IGUDAR

> IGUDAR is an AI coworker for event safety and security plans. It builds a 3D digital twin of the site, simulates vehicle risk and helps the professional draft the plan; the appointed professional reviews and signs it.

Canonical website: https://igudar.it/
Contact: contact@igudar.it
Primary language: Italian
Area served: Italy
Status: active development and 2026 pilot programmes

## What IGUDAR does

- Builds a measurable digital twin of the real site from surveys and plans.
- Simulates vehicle paths and impacts to compare protection layouts before the event.
- Collects calculations, simulation results and references into a draft safety plan.
- Highlights assumptions and results so the qualified professional can review, correct and sign.

## Platform modules

1. Vehicle risk: available; validated on the Pordenone case study.
2. Egress: in development.
3. Capacity: in development.
4. Emergency access: in development.
5. Fire safety: in development.
6. Regulatory compliance: in development.

## Verified positioning

- IGUDAR does not replace the qualified professional.
- AI coordinates the analysis but does not invent physical results.
- Final validity depends on input data, applicable rules and professional review.
- Internal case study: Piazzale XX Settembre, Pordenone. Compared with manual placement on the same site and with the same budget, the IGUDAR protection layout recorded 39.3% fewer simulated casualties in that specific scenario. This result is not a general guarantee.

## Intended users

- Safety professionals and technical practices.
- Event organisers.
- Public administrations.

## Scope

IGUDAR supports event safety and security planning; it is not a ticketing or invitation-management platform. Module availability must be distinguished from the development roadmap.
